select * from om.om_tasks where task_name like '%CBCEXAPP%'

-----insert data in om tasks table
INSERT INTO om.om_tasks (TASK_NAME,DATA_LAYER,SCHEMA_NAME,TABLE_NAME,SOURCE_CODE,DESCRIPTION,UPDATE_DATETIME,CREATE_DATETIME,MONTHEND,FREQUENCY_LOADING,TABLE_TYPE)
SELECT 'TSK_CI_DEPOSITS_RETAIL','CI',NULL,'CI_DEPOSITS_RETAIL','DEP',NULL,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),NULL,'WEEKDAYS','SNAPSHOT';GO

-----insert data in om task dependency table 
INSERT INTO om.om_task_dependency (DEPENDENCY_ID,TASK_NAME,DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME,MONTHEND)
SELECT (SELECT MAX(ISNULL(DEPENDENCY_ID,0)) FROM om.om_task_dependency) + 1,'TSK_EDS_DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP','TSK_CI_DEPOSITS_RETAIL',NULL; GO

select task_name from om.om_tasks where task_name like 'tsk_eds_DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP%' union all
select task_name from om.om_tasks where task_name like 'tsk_eds_DEPOSIT_FACT%' union all

select distinct * from om.om_task_run where task_name in (
'tsk_eds_DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP'
,'tsk_eds_DEPOSIT_FACT'
,'tsk_eds_BRANCH_DIM'
,'tsk_eds_CUSTOMER_DIM'
,'tsk_eds_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING'
)

insert into om.om_task_run
select task_run_id,upper('tsk_eds_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING'),pipeline_runID,status_id,data_layer,process_date,start_datetime,end_datetime,create_datetime,tgt_reccount from om.om_task_run  where pipeline_runid = '0ae2ed96-0221-4e79-8829-7c91882529eb' and data_layer = 'EDS'

update om.om_task_run set process_date = '2023-09-01' where task_name in (
'tsk_eds_DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP'
,'tsk_eds_DEPOSIT_FACT'
,'tsk_eds_BRANCH_DIM'

,'tsk_eds_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING'
)
